purpose: Five transparent Moai turntable views for horizontal pointer tracking

assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: central frame of a 5-frame horizontal mouse-following website logo. Use the attached moai emoji as the exact design and material reference. Make ONE matching moai head, now facing perfectly straight toward the viewer (zero yaw), neutral solemn expression. Preserve the short chunky gray-mauve stone sculpture, broad nose, heavy continuous brow, recessed dark eyes, closed thick lips, rounded rectangular head and rear slab, smooth stylized emoji shading and simple soft highlights. No realism, no added details, no pupils, no neck, no pedestal. Pure transparent background, no checkerboard drawn in, no floor or cast shadow. Square canvas 1024x1024, full head entirely visible, head centered at x=512 and vertical center=512, occupy about 72% canvas height with generous identical margins. Camera at mid-face height, orthographic, head upright without tilt or vertical rotation. This is the master neutral frame for four subsequent matching rotations. No labels, text, other objects or extra heads.

Change ONLY the horizontal yaw of this very same gray-mauve stylized moai emoji head: turn it 45 degrees toward the viewer's LEFT, nose pointing visibly toward the LEFT edge of the image, show the RIGHT side of the head. Camera fixed, eye-level orthographic, no vertical turn, no roll/tilt. SAME height, SAME head top/bottom coordinates, SAME optical center x and y, SAME orthographic camera distance and proportions. Preserve the identical heavy brow, long broad nose, small black oval nostrils, closed curved thick lips, stone cheek panels and pale simple highlight patches. Preserve original neutral solemn expression, colors and smooth emoji shading; do NOT add pupils, realistic texture, extra features, neck or pedestal. Keep the full head uncropped with margins matching the reference. Square 1280x1280 canvas, top of head around y=155 and base around y=1110, optical center x=640; blank margins all around. Pure transparent background with genuine alpha. No floor shadow, no checkerboard baked in, no text, no layout, no arrows, no additional objects or heads. This is a coherent turntable rotation of the reference, not a new statue design.
